title: Determinant detects perfect matchings
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $R$ be a nontrivial commutative ring, and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix. The determinant of the polynomial matrix with entry $X_{i,j}$ when $A_{i,j}=\mathrm{true}$ and zero otherwise is nonzero if and only if the associated bipartite graph, with an edge from left index $i$ to right index $j$ exactly when $A_{i,j}=\mathrm{true}$, has a perfect matching.
